# Catch oversized or slow PDF decompression before it freezes resume intake

## What & Why
The local parser now has byte, output, and deadline limits, but the safety boundary should stay protected by regression fixtures that exercise oversized uncompressed streams and malformed Flate data.

## Done looks like
- Local-only tests cover oversized uncompressed content and malformed or expanding Flate streams.
- Each fixture fails with the unsupported-document explanation without hanging the test process.
- No personal resume values or uploaded network fixtures are used.
